'''Hu Ying''' ({{zh|c=胡英|p=Hú Yīng}}; 19 June 1934 – 27 August 2023) was a Chinese physical chemist who was a professor at [[East China University of Science and Technology]], an academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]].<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.bjnews.com.cn/detail/169322945093053.html |script-title=zh:胡英院士逝世 |work=bjnews.com.cn |date=28 August 2023 |access-date=1 October 2023 |language=zh}}</ref>

==Biography==
Hu was born in [[Shanghai]], on 19 June 1934, while his [[Ancestral home (Chinese)|ancestral home]] is in [[Yingshan County, Hubei]].<ref name="tie">{{cite news |author1=Shen Xiaodong ({{lang|zh|沈小栋}}) |url=https://news.xinmin.cn/2023/08/29/32460609.html |script-title=zh:中国科学院院士、我国著名化学工程学家胡英教授因病逝世 |work=xinmin.cn |date=29 August 2023 |access-date=1 October 2023 |language=zh}}</ref> After graduating from Shanghai High School in 1950, he was admitted to National Jiaotong University, and soon transferred to East China University of Chemical Technology (now [[East China University of Science and Technology]]).<ref name="tie"/> He taught there after graduation.<ref name="tie"/> He joined the [[Chinese Communist Party]] (CCP) in 1953.<ref name="tie"/> He was a visiting scholar at the [[University of California, Berkeley]] from 1982 to 1984.

He died of an illness at Zhongshan Hospital in Shanghai, on 27 August 2023, at the age of 89.<ref name="tie"/><ref>{{cite news |author1=Huang Yanhao ({{lang|zh|黄晏浩}}) |url=https://mini.caixin.com/2023-09-06/102100910.html |script-title=zh:化学工程学家、“上海教育功臣”胡英院士去世，89岁 |work=caixin.com |date=6 September 2023 |access-date=1 October 2023 |language=zh}}</ref>

==Honours and awards==
* 1993 Member of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] (CAS)
